pass_a_gloss: Demons fatted by smoke in thick air; sacrifice uprooted save to Lord; no fellowship.
pass_b_english: Since some, not beholding the earthly intent of the hostile power's assault, suppose the idols nothing — hear: the demons, dwelling in earth's thick air, are fatted by sacrifice-smoke and blood, and by such food grow strong to deceive. 'He that sacrificeth to gods shall be uprooted' (Exodus 22:20 (LXX 21)) — save to the Lord alone. To sacrifice is to feed demons and subject oneself to them: 'the things the nations sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God; and I would not ye have fellowship with demons.' (1 Corinthians 10:20) Flee then the demons' table, lest, fed by you, they boast to have overcome God's soldiers (Exodus 22:20).
